title: A&A-EUcoins
summary: Marketplace auction for collectible coins: live bidding, catalog, seller dashboard and admin panel.
description: The full path from idea to a working product on a real server: auctions with bids and max auto-bids, a catalog with faceted filters, per-seller carts, guest checkout, disputes with document uploads, order chat, invoices and seller commissions. Grows as the core project of my own business.
highlights: Live auctions: bids, auto-bids, price polling every 5 seconds
Catalog with filters: country, metal, condition
Seller dashboard: commissions, PDF invoices, statistics
Admin panel with QA bots (buyer / seller / auditor) and load tests
Docker, deploy scripts and backups
metrics: QA bot roles: buyer · seller · auditor

title: Accounting Pro
summary: Offline accounting for small German businesses: invoices, EÜR and DATEV export.
description: A desktop app built for a real market: invoices with PDF export, the automatic §19 UStG Kleinunternehmer clause, a dashboard with revenue, expenses and profit, EÜR with cost of goods, DATEV export for the Steuerberater, inventory with Excel export and a change journal. I use it myself for my own business books.
highlights: Invoices RE-2026-0001 with PDF export and a document archive
EÜR with COGS and DATEV export for the tax advisor
Dashboard: revenue, margin, Kleinunternehmer limit
Three UI languages: DE · RU · EN
Portable build and Inno Setup installer

screenshots.caption: Products: inventory, prices and sales history

title: DevHub
summary: A single local-development hub for Windows: all projects and services in one window.
description: A tool I built for my own work with dozens of projects: automatic stack detection (Node, PHP, Laravel, Django, Flask, .NET, Docker), starting and stopping services with dependencies, an embedded terminal and profiles in a local database. Release 1.1.2 with smoke, launch and e2e tests.
highlights: Auto-detected run commands: npm, pnpm, yarn, bun, artisan, runserver, dotnet, Docker Compose
Services with dependencies: ordered start, process-tree stop
Embedded terminal on node-pty + xterm
Folder scanning up to 2 levels / 80 directories
Smoke / launch / e2e tests, including 40 test projects

screenshots.caption: A list of 136 local projects with filters

metrics: test projects in the e2e suite

title: Aura Browser
summary: A privacy-first browser for Windows: isolated tabs and fingerprinting protection.
description: "You are everywhere. You are nowhere" — a browser with isolated tab profiles (Trusted / Tabs / Archive), a fresh fingerprint for every anonymous session, one-shortcut profile burning, smart bookmarks with categories and a long-unused section. A shipped product with an installer and a portable build.
highlights: Isolated tab profiles with separate data
Anonymous sessions with a fresh fingerprint
Profile burn with a single Ctrl+W shortcut
Smart bookmarks: categories and "long unused"
NSIS installer + portable

screenshots.caption: Start screen: quick sign-in and an anonymous session

title: MY TIME
summary: An offline one-tap time tracker: timer, plans, goals and mood.
description: An app about honest time tracking without pressure: one tap on a category and the timer runs, plans and facts live separately, mood and a daily question help you notice what matters. Fully offline: data stays on the device. Covered by 49 unit tests and packaged as an Android app via Capacitor.
highlights: Timestamp-based timer: pauses and atomic category switching
Plans with repeats and a plan-versus-fact comparison
2 / 5 / 10 minute quests and reality checks
49 unit tests (Vitest), JSON / CSV export
Android build via Capacitor

screenshots.caption: The Today screen: categories and mood

title: CryptoGemScanner
summary: A crypto-signals service: new-listing scanner, momentum scoring and auto-publishing to Telegram.
description: The system watches new listings via the CoinMarketCap and CryptoCompare APIs, computes momentum scoring (price, volume, dynamics), publishes signals with TP1/TP2 targets and a stop-loss, maintains a risk zone for published coins and a trade journal with PnL. Runs as a website and as a Windows desktop app.
highlights: Real API data: CoinMarketCap, CryptoCompare
Signal-quality scoring and momentum (A/B/C grades)
Post-monitoring risk zone: soft/hard alerts
Automatic Telegram posts: TP1/TP2/SL
SQLite trade journal with PnL and a Flask admin

title: CactusOS
summary: A design case: a privacy-first Android ROM for Xiaomi Redmi 6A — specification and a clickable prototype.
description: A project about making a phone trustworthy for small-business employees: specification v1.0 (dual SIM, employees with PINs, PERSONAL/WORK spaces, a DENIED→ASK→ALLOWED permission panel, zero telemetry, SELinux enforcing and FBE on top of LineageOS) plus an interactive HTML prototype of the UI with lock screen, people, settings and SMS screens.
highlights: Specification v1.0 "approved baseline"
Clickable UI prototype: RU / EN
An "employee + owner" model with PINs and spaces
Zero telemetry and no Google account
Base: Android 11 / LineageOS 18.1, kernel 4.9

title: NAJMO
summary: An SMS system for local business: a PC operator, a dual-SIM Android app and a client panel.
description: A working v3.5 system: Polish SMS chains with correct district declension, limits and sending windows, STOP handling, a 14-day funnel analytics across days and lists, Excel/TXT/CSV reports and APK self-update. The client panel ships with a password, CSRF protection and an audit log.
highlights: Android app (APK) sending via 2 SIMs over USB
Polish declension in texts: 100 code-to-district pairs
Limits of 300 SMS/day per SIM and a 09:00–20:00 window
14-day funnel analytics: by hour, list and SIM
Client panel: CSRF, audit log, password-guess lockout

title: Supply Lens
summary: A procurement tool: a base of Chinese suppliers, price-list import and comparison.
description: A desktop app for comparing supplier price lists: parsing lines with specs and prices, quick import via Ctrl+V, cross-supplier comparison with the best price highlighted, full landed cost with customs, shipping and commission, Excel export and invoice photos.
highlights: Price-line parsing: series, CPU, RAM, SSD, GPU, screen, price
Supplier comparison with the best price highlighted
Full landed cost: customs, shipping, commission
Invoice photos and Excel export
Dark and light themes, installer v1.1

title: VESNA
summary: A local AI coding agent: like Cursor, but fully on my own hardware, no cloud.
description: Experiment v0.6: an agent with read/patch/grep/shell/git/web tools running on embedded llama.cpp with local models (Qwen2.5-Coder, DeepSeek Coder). Six modes — from a quick question to a four-agent team (Multi) — plus a training-lab sandbox for autonomous learning and a web interface.
highlights: 6 modes: Agent, Explore, Quick, Plan, Execute, Multi
Tools: files, patches, grep, shell, pytest, git, web
Local models via llama.cpp — no cloud
Training-lab: an autonomous learning sandbox
Web UI (FastAPI) + desktop (pywebview), installer
